name: 9 Kings
short_description: A fast-paced roguelike kingdom builder. Grow your empire and fight massive battles against powerful rival kings. Break the game with thousands of insane builds to become the King of Kings.

identity.core_loop: Pick a card, place it on a small grid, watch the battle, survive the year, grow.
identity.ui_and_game_feel: Snappy card drops onto plots; battles play out by themselves; quick, readable cause and effect.

hud_coverage.method: Oracle study from public knowledge of the game, in our own words; not yet measured on capture

information_grammar.note: Plot buffs and threats sit on tiles; the hand of cards is the one overlay; the enemy's banner tells you who comes next.

identity.art_direction: Chunky pixel-painterly kingdoms on a floating board.
identity.audio_mood: Punchy war drums and short stings per placement.
identity.lessons_for_abbies_world: A tiny board plus big consequences: every placement should visibly change the next fight.

sources: oracle study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no store fetch, no game files)
summary: A roguelite kingdom builder where each year you place cards on a 3x3 plot and an enemy king attacks.
